title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text: 9. Calls for the EU to expand its sanctions against Russian media outlets and other institutions, including academic and cultural institutions*, conducting disinformation and information manipulation campaigns, historical falsification, and the promotion of imperialistic ideology supporting and justifying Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and calls on the Member States to swiftly and thoroughly implement these sanctions and to dedicate sufficient resources to effectively addressing this hybrid warfare; calls for the EU and the Member States to step up their support for the independent Russian media in exile in order to enable diverse voices in the Russian-language media;
